built:
[mcp_servers.char-bearer]
startup_timeout_sec = 10
url = "http://127.0.0.1:<port>/v1/mcp-gateway/char-bearer/mcp"
[mcp_servers.char-bearer.http_headers]
"Authorization" = "Bearer OTO_SESSION_JWT"

[mcp_servers.char-gitish]
startup_timeout_sec = 10
tool_timeout_sec = 120
command = "<tmp>/mcps/custom/char-gitish/venv/bin/python"
args = ["<tmp>/mcps/custom/char-gitish/server.py"]
env = { "OTO_STRIP_KEYS" = "GIT_CONFIG_COUNT,GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0,GIT_CONFIG_KEY_1,GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0,GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_1,OTO_CLI_TOKEN", "OTO_TOOL_STANDIN" = "{\"account\":\"b91b695cc597cbac\",\"fetch\":true,\"label\":\"Gitish\",\"stamp\":\"1.0.0+0.0.0\",\"v\":1}", "OTO_CLI_TOKEN" = "" }

[mcp_servers.char-http]
startup_timeout_sec = 30
tool_timeout_sec = 120
url = "http://127.0.0.1:<port>/v1/mcp-gateway/char-http/mcp/"
[mcp_servers.char-http.http_headers]
"Authorization" = "Bearer OTO_SESSION_JWT"

[mcp_servers.char-keyed]
startup_timeout_sec = 10
url = "http://127.0.0.1:<port>/v1/mcp-gateway/char-keyed/mcp"
[mcp_servers.char-keyed.http_headers]
"Authorization" = "Bearer OTO_SESSION_JWT"

[mcp_servers.char-sse]
startup_timeout_sec = 10
url = "https://sse.example.test/sse"

[mcp_servers.char-tools]
startup_timeout_sec = 10
tool_timeout_sec = 180
command = "<tmp>/mcps/custom/char-tools/venv/bin/python"
args = ["<tmp>/mcps/custom/char-tools/server.py", "--mode", "fast", "char-reg", "quote\"and\\back", "line\nbreak"]
env = { "CHAR_STATIC" = "1", "CHAR_DIR" = "<tmp>/mcps/custom/char-tools/data", "CHAR_ROOT" = "<platform-root>/x", "CHAR_AGENT" = "char-reg", "CHAR_CHAT" = "", "CHAR_OWNER" = "", "CHAR_USER" = "", "CHAR_SCOPE" = "", "CHAR_ASK" = "", "CHAR_PROXY" = "http://localhost:<port>", "CHAR_REF" = "http://192.168.77.10:9100/metrics", "CHAR_MASTER" = "${proxy_api_key}", "CHAR_MODE" = "fast", "CHAR_LIMIT" = "9", "CHAR_ON" = "true", "CHAR_OFF" = "false", "CHAR_SAVED" = "saved", "OTO_TOOL_STANDIN" = "{\"account\":\"\",\"fetch\":false,\"label\":\"Char Tools\",\"stamp\":\"1.0.0+0.0.0\",\"v\":1}", "OTO_CLI_TOKEN" = "" }
